subject: Discovery recap + one quick ask (ParcelGrid)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + one quick ask (ParcelGrid)

Hi Emily — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our 30-minute call and one small ask at the bottom.

Key points we heard:
- ParcelGrid processes ~2.5M shipping labels/month across North America; latency spikes on peak days cause a measurable increase in manual tickets.
- Primary goal: reduce end-to-end label generation latency and lower error-rate for atypical SKUs.
- Constraints: Elastic infra on GCP, data retention policy requires logs stored for 90 days, SOC2 in progress.

What Redwood showed:
- Runtime optimizations that reduced token-level latency in our demo model by ~35% on similar workloads.
- Options for private deployment (VPC) and a Dedicated pool for predictable throughput.
- Mini-pilot path: sandbox ingest (S3), 2-week evaluation with a 1k-label/day sample, dashboard access for latency/cost.

Suggested next steps (what we’d like from you):
1) Quick confirmation that trial data share is acceptable (we can use hashed identifiers).
2) If yes, pick a 2-week window in June for the mini-pilot.
3) If you’d prefer not to move forward, a one-line “not right now” helps us close the loop.

Attachments: parcelgrid-discovery-notes.pdf (call notes), demo-recording-20280601.mp4 (30-min recording), pilot-outline-template.docx

If you don’t have a moment right now, no problem — a one-line reply is totally fine. Would you be open to a 15-minute sync next week to lock a window?

Thanks,

Hi Emily — last note from me on this thread unless I hear otherwise. I don’t want to keep pinging you if ParcelGrid is deprioritizing this. Two quick options so you can pick whichever is easiest: 

A) "Not right now" — reply with those two words and I’ll close this on our end.
B) "Send pilot" — reply and I’ll share a short ingest checklist and two kickoff times.

Why this helps: we track pilot requests tightly so we can allocate Dedicated pool slots; your simple response will avoid unnecessary internal hold time for both teams.

If you prefer a short call to decide, here are two tentative windows: Tuesday 6/20 11:00–11:15am PT or Wednesday 6/21 2:00–2:15pm PT. I’ll only lock them if you confirm.

Thanks for the candid feedback either way — it’s genuinely helpful.

Neha
